qs.q: During a radical neck dissection, a surgeon identifies the spinal accessory nerve crossing the posterior triangle. Which muscle is primarily innervated by this nerve?
qs.e: Cranial nerve XI provides motor innervation to both the sternocleidomastoid and trapezius muscles.
